metaDescription: Roofmaster won our 2026 Roofing Replacement & Repair award for Ottawa, Ontario. Shingle, metal and flat roofing serving Ottawa Valley since 1981.
summary: Roofmaster is a long-established Ottawa roofing contractor, serving the city and the broader Ottawa Valley since 1981. The company handles shingle, metal and flat roofing for both residential and commercial clients.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Roofmaster offers shingle roofing, metal roofing, flat roofing, roof repairs, roof inspections and eavestroughing. Covering all three major roof types under one contractor is useful for commercial or mixed-use properties that may have both a sloped shingle section and a flat roof section on the same building.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: With roots dating to 1981, Roofmaster has operated in the Ottawa market for over four decades, a track record worth asking about directly for references from different eras of the business's history. Roof inspections are listed as a standalone service, useful for homeowners who want an assessment before committing to a repair or replacement quote.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so ask the company directly for recent local references, particularly for a project matching your roof type, whether shingle, metal or flat. Ask whether a written inspection report is provided separately from a repair or replacement quote.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company serves Ottawa and the broader Ottawa Valley, for both residential and commercial roofing. Homeowners further out in the Ottawa Valley should confirm travel coverage before booking.

strengths: Over four decades of operating history in the Ottawa roofing market, dating to 1981.
Covers all three major roof types, shingle, metal and flat, under one contractor.
Offers roof inspections as a standalone service, separate from a repair or replacement sale.
Also handles eavestroughing, a common companion job to roof replacement.
Serves both residential and commercial clients across Ottawa and the Ottawa Valley.
considerations: No public reviews are listed yet, so ask for recent local references before a full roof replacement.
Best suited to standard shingle, metal and flat roof work; ask directly about capacity for specialty or heritage roofing materials.
Roof replacement is seasonal, weather-dependent work, so expect scheduling pressure during peak fall and spring windows.
Not a fit if you need same-day emergency tarping outside their stated service hours; confirm emergency response availability directly.
bestFor: Homeowners needing a shingle, metal or flat roof replacement
Anyone wanting a roof inspection before deciding on repair versus replacement
Commercial properties with mixed roof types under one building
Homeowners bundling eavestrough replacement with a new roof
questionsToAsk: Can you provide a written roof inspection report separate from a repair or replacement quote?
What shingle or metal roofing manufacturer warranties do you install under, and are you a certified installer?
How do you handle flashing and ventilation as part of a full roof replacement, not just the shingles themselves?
What is your current scheduling lead time for the upcoming season?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: Roofmaster was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top roofing contractor serving Ottawa, Ontario, based on public services and business history, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: How long has Roofmaster been in business?
faq.a: The company states it has served Ottawa and the Ottawa Valley since 1981.

faq.q: What roof types do they work on?
faq.a: Shingle, metal and flat roofing, along with repairs, inspections and eavestroughing.

faq.q: Do they serve areas outside Ottawa itself?
faq.a: Yes, the company describes its service area as Ottawa and the broader Ottawa Valley.
